model_annotations.Bulgarian: На този вертикално ориентиран стълбов диаграма се показва точността (%) на пет различни модели – DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO и PPO – при трите задачи: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос представя задачите, а вертикалната ос показва точността в проценти, със скала от 50 до 62. Всеки модел е представен с различен цвят и шаблон: DAPO+Self-reflection (син), GRPO (оранжев с диагонални линии), DAPO (сив с диагонални линии), SRPO (оранжев) и PPO (зелен с хоризонтални линии). За задачата Mathverse, моделът DAPO+Self-reflection достига най-висока точност от около 56.2%, докато DAPO е най-нисък с около 53.2%. За MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection има точност около 57%, а PPO – около 54.7%. За задачата Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection достига най-висока точност от около 60.8%, докато PPO е най-нисък с около 59.2%. Всички модели показват по-висока точност при задачата Physics, следвана от MMLU и най-ниска при Mathverse.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该柱状图比较了四种不同方法在三个不同数据集（Mathverse、MMLU 和 Physics）上的准确率（Accuracy (%)）。横轴表示数据集，纵轴表示准确率，单位为百分比，范围从50%到62%。图例显示了四种方法：DAPO+Self-reflection（蓝色实心柱）、GRPO（橙色斜纹柱）、DAPO（浅蓝色斜线柱）、PPO+Self-reflection（绿色实心柱）和PPO（青色斜线柱）。在Mathverse数据集上，DAPO+Self-reflection的准确率约为56.2%，GRPO约为55.5%，DAPO约为53.5%，PPO+Self-reflection约为54.8%，PPO约为53.8%。在MMLU数据集上，DAPO+Self-reflection的准确率约为57.2%，GRPO约为56.2%，DAPO约为56.2%，PPO+Self-reflection约为56.5%，PPO约为55.0%。在Physics数据集上，DAPO+Self-reflection的准确率最高，约为61.5%，GRPO约为58.5%，DAPO约为57.5%，PPO+Self-reflection约为59.5%，PPO约为57.0%。总体来看，DAPO+Self-reflection在所有数据集上均表现出最高的准确率。
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major tick marks at 50, 52, 54, 56, 58, 60, and 62. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. Each domain has a group of five bars, with distinct patterns and colors corresponding to the methods as defined in the legend. In the Mathverse domain, DAPO+Self-reflection (blue) reaches approximately 56.2%, GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes) is at about 53.5%, DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes) is at 53%, PPO+Self-reflection (dark green) is at 54.5%, and SRPO (orange) is at 55.8%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection (blue) is at about 57%, GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes) is at 55.8%, DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes) is at 55.8%, PPO+Self-reflection (dark green) is at 56.2%, and SRPO (orange) is at 57.2%. In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection (blue) achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 60.8%, followed by GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes) at 58.2%, DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes) at 57.5%, SRPO (orange) at 60.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection (dark green) at 59.2%. The bars are sorted by domain on the x-axis, and the legend clearly identifies each method by its color and pattern.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit (in Prozent) verschiedener Methoden in drei verschiedenen Bereichen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die vertikale Achse stellt die Genauigkeit in Prozent dar, mit einem Wertebereich von 50 % bis 62 % und einer Skaleneinteilung von 2 %. Die horizontalen Achsenkategorien sind die drei Bereiche, und für jeden Bereich sind fünf verschiedene Methoden dargestellt, die durch farbige Balken mit unterschiedlichen Musterungen repräsentiert werden: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), GRPO (orange mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (blau mit diagonalen Strichen), SRPO (orange) und PPO+Self-reflection (grün). Die Legende oben rechts ordnet die Farben und Muster den jeweiligen Methoden zu. In allen drei Bereichen ist die Genauigkeit der Methode DAPO+Self-reflection (blauer Balken) am höchsten, gefolgt von SRPO (oranger Balken), GRPO (orangefarbener Balken mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (blauer Balken mit diagonalen Strichen) und PPO+Self-reflection (grüner Balken). Die höchste Genauigkeit wird in Physics für DAPO+Self-reflection mit etwa 61 % erreicht, während die niedrigste Genauigkeit in Mathverse für DAPO mit etwa 53 % liegt.
